profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer & Product Builder | Architecture, Full-Stack Engineering, Data & UI/UX | 25+ Years Shipping Software
profile.summary:
I've spent 25+ years building software, but I've never been particularly interested in staying inside one box.
 
I'm a hands-on senior software engineer who enjoys owning the full path from an idea to a working product: understanding the problem, designing the user experience, modeling the data, defining the architecture, building the system, and getting it into production.
 
My strongest work tends to happen where engineering, product, and UI/UX overlap. I enjoy taking complicated business problems and turning them into products that feel simple to the people using them. That means I'm as comfortable working through architecture and data models as I am iterating on an interface or writing production code.
 
Over my career I've built and shipped products across a wide range of technologies and environments, working as both an individual contributor and technical leader. I still love being hands-on, but I also enjoy setting technical direction, mentoring engineers, making product decisions, and helping teams turn ambiguous ideas into something real.
 
More recently, my work has centered on modern TypeScript/React stacks, full-stack architecture, data-intensive applications, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted development.
 
I'm most interested in roles where I can combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership and product ownership — especially teams that care as much about building the right experience as they do about building the system behind it.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead architecture and hands-on development of SparrowTV's advertising technology platform, owning the product across UI/UX, application architecture, APIs, data modeling, cloud infrastructure, and deployment.
 
• Built the multi-tenant web application with TypeScript, Next.js 16, and React, including campaign management, creative workflows, audience targeting, geographic delivery analytics, performance reporting, and operational dashboards.
 
• Designed and implemented a Go REST API using an OpenAPI 3 contract, backed by PostgreSQL 18 on AWS RDS and S3 for creative/media storage.
 
• Designed the multi-tenant PostgreSQL data architecture with Row-Level Security (RLS), providing tenant isolation throughout the platform.
 
• Implemented authentication and identity with Better Auth backed by Neon, with authorization integrated across application and data layers.
 
• Provisioned AWS infrastructure with Terraform and built CI/CD pipelines for both the Next.js application on Vercel and Go API/AWS infrastructure.
 
• Work directly with executive leadership on product strategy and translate complex television advertising workflows into product architecture, data models, and user experiences.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contract software engineer working across mobile, web, and backend systems for Vironix Health's remote patient monitoring and telehealth platform.
 
• Built and shipped Vironix Ops, a React Native (Expo) clinician mobile application for iOS and Android, taking it from initial setup through App Store and Google Play release using EAS.
 
• Rebuilt and released the patient-facing RPM mobile app, including real-time chat, medical-device pairing, and vitals monitoring.
 
• Developed a React 18 / Vite / React Admin back-office application supporting clinician workflows and patient monitoring.
 
• Worked across the FastAPI / SQLAlchemy backend, real-time chat infrastructure, and integrations with blood pressure monitors, pulse oximeters, and weight scales.
 
• Built EAS build and release pipelines, version automation, and multi-environment configuration supporting both mobile applications.
